precepts.text: Seek not death in the error of your life: and pull not upon yourselves destruction with the works of your own hands. When you put that sin above everything, that is what you are seeking: death. Money can be your destruction. Women can be your destruction. Food, alcohol, drugs can be your destruction. That is the appetite in us that we constantly want to feed, and we have to stop it.
precepts.point: This man walked with Christ. He saw the healing, he was around the commandment keeping; but that money lust is never enough. He desired money and riches more than anything. And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver. And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him. Ultimately Judas betrayed Lord Jesus Christ.
precepts.why:
“Seek not death in the error of your life: and pull not upon yourselves destruction with the works of your hands.” Don't seek death. When you put that sin above everything, that is exactly what you are seeking: death. Judas did it with his own hands when he “sought opportunity to betray him” for thirty pieces of silver, and he destroyed himself.

Money can be your destruction. Women can be your destruction. Food can be your destruction. Alcohol and drugs can be your destruction. These are the appetites in us that we constantly want to feed, and we have to stop it.

This is war, and people will give you up for money. It runs through history: the Black Panther Party, Martin Luther King, Malcolm X. We had a whole Israelite camp back in the day break up because of money, and today certain brothers get pushed on every platform as the face of the Israelites while the bishops and deacons really out here teaching are kept off. If you are weak in spirit, betrayal comes with money.

So be wise. A lot of times we are going to fall, but you don't sit down in a fetal position; you repent and move forward and sin no more. The destruction a man pulls on himself comes from the works of his own hands, and the way out is to stop feeding the appetite before it becomes your demise, like it became Judas'.

precepts.text: For froward thoughts separate from God. Being froward means you are thinking outside of the Bible. When your mind is not on the Lord, you are separated from him; you cannot be both.
precepts.point: Pride. Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall. You think you know it all, you think you have all the wisdom and understanding; but pride is the progenitor of your destruction, because pride removes correction. You do not want to hear it. Pride isolates you, and pride precedes the collapse.
precepts.why:
Sirach says pride begins when one departs from God. The Wisdom of Solomon shows how a man departs: “For froward thoughts separate from God”.

Being froward means you are thinking outside of the Bible. Period. That's what it is.

When your mind is not on the Lord, you are separated from him. You can't be both. So pride starts in the thoughts: the moment your thinking goes outside of the scriptures, you have separated yourself from God, and a haughty spirit is on its way to the fall. That is why the man who meditates on the scriptures has something to pull from when temptation comes, and the froward man doesn't.

precepts.text: The holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit, and remove from thoughts that are without understanding. Discipline is a holy spirit with a cap and a limit; the man who cannot stop eating worships himself. You cannot obtain discipline without the Holy Spirit, and there are levels to it, up to the disciples working miracles. Full access comes through disciplining the food intake and the sex outtake, the two stumbling blocks that keep us from progressing.
precepts.point: Whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things: when am I going to eat, the things pleasing to the eyes and the flesh. Overindulging outside God's guidelines takes you out of the realm of discipline into the realm of Satan.

note.label: Power Under Control: Food, Sex & Self-Mastery

precepts.why:
Paul speaks of those “Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.” When we overindulge excessively, outside the guidelines God gave us, we start to operate outside the realm of God, outside the realm of discipline, and into the realm of Satan. That is why God gave us a law.

“For the holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit, and remove from thoughts that are without understanding.” The Bible says discipline is a holy spirit. There is a cap and a limit. The man who cannot stop eating is worshipping himself, because God says to eat in moderation and to eat what nourishes; do not eat just to eat. Christ said his meat was to do the will of the Father, but people followed him just for the food, because their god was the belly.

Discipline has to be practiced. People wonder why they cannot obtain discipline: it is because they do not have the Holy Spirit. There is a level of the Holy Spirit given to you because you know your nationality, but there are levels to accessing it and gaining power in it. The disciples reached the level where they worked miracles.

Full access to the Holy Spirit comes through disciplining our food intake and our sex outtake. Food and sex are closely related in the body: one is for procreation of life, the other for nourishing that life. Those two are our stumbling blocks, the two things that keep us from progressing and moving forward.

precepts.text: Abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul, including lust for food.
precepts.point: Stop overeating and snacking, fast more, exercise, and ask the Lord never to remove that spirit of discipline.
precepts.why:
“For the holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit, and remove from thoughts that are without understanding, and will not abide when unrighteousness cometh in.” If you are deceitful, that holy spirit of discipline is not going to live with you, and it will not stick around when you are in sin.

Peter names the war: “Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul”. That includes the lust for food. Overeating and snacking is a fleshly lust warring against your soul, and it drives out the spirit of discipline.

Thoughts “without understanding” are not knowing that we need you to do the work, so we need you healthy; your kids need you and you need yourself. So stop hating yourself and become disciplined. Fix your mind first and don’t say I can’t. Stop overeating, stop snacking, start fasting more, drink water instead of soda and juice, make exercise a lifestyle, eat light, and take care of your body.

Pray and fast that the Lord keeps your discipline. Ask him to change your appetite and strip away the cravings for sugar and processed carbs, and ask the Lord never to remove his holy spirit from you, so you can stay disciplined.

precepts.text: God made not death, and the generations of the world were healthful.
precepts.point: After Adam transgressed, the ways became narrow, and Israel must now labour for the inheritance.

note.label: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World

precepts.why:
The entrances of the elder world “were wide and sure, and brought immortal fruit.” Wisdom shows what that world was like: “For God made not death: neither hath he pleasure in the destruction of the living. For he created all things, that they might have their being: and the generations of the world were healthful; and there is no poison of destruction in them, nor the kingdom of death upon the earth”.

The generations of the world were healthful: we were living forever. There was no poison of destruction in us and no kingdom of death. The kingdom of death was established after Adam fell, when Satan was given power over this earth and began ruling it, him and his children. The kingdom of death is the white man and Satan ruling the earth. Before that was the kingdom of Adam, the kingdom of heaven. That is why Moses could promise “the days of heaven upon the earth”: he saw Adam rule.

“For righteousness is immortal”: keep God's laws and you live forever. “But ungodly men with their works and words called it to them: for when they thought to have it their friend, they consumed to nought, and made a covenant with it”. A lot of our people have made a covenant with death, worshipping Satan and living in the kingdom of death. That is why the last thing Christ has to conquer is death, and then there will be no more death, period.

precepts.text: Righteousness is immortal; the righteous seed endures forever.
precepts.point: Righteousness is immortal, and righteousness is defined by the law: it shall be our righteousness if we observe to do all these commandments. Abram's faith showed itself in his works.

note.label: Genesis 15: The Covenant and the Four Hundred Years

precepts.why:
“He believed in the Lord; and he counted it to him for righteousness.” And “righteousness is immortal.” The seed Abram was told to count in the stars is a righteous seed, and a righteous seed endures for ever.

Righteousness is not a passing thing. What was counted to Abram when he believed carries on in his seed, as many as the stars of heaven, and it does not die.

precepts.text: The ear of jealousy heareth all things; beware of murmuring, for the mouth that belieth slayeth the soul.
precepts.point: Many speak evil against leadership because they do not like when judgment comes out; a problem with the leadership the Most High set up is a problem with the Most High Himself.
precepts.why:
The Most High hates it when His people complain. He had just destroyed Egypt for Israel, its land, its infrastructure, its firstborn, and drowned its army in the sea, all to save the people out; then on the other side of the wilderness, at the first trial or tribulation, the people jumped off His bandwagon. “And when the people complained, it displeased the Lord: and the Lord heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the Lord burnt among them.” The same is still being done to this day.

“Therefore he that speaketh unrighteous things cannot be hid: neither shall vengeance, when it punisheth, pass by him.” Vengeance, when it punisheth, does not pass by the murmurer; he receives the vengeance of the Lord, which is what the fire in the uttermost parts of the camp was.

“For inquisition shall be made into the counsels of the ungodly: and the sound of his words shall come unto the Lord for the manifestation of his wicked deeds. For the ear of jealousy heareth all things: and the noise of murmurings is not hid.” Nothing spoken behind closed doors is hidden. Inquisition is made into the counsels of the ungodly by the Lord and His angels, and the sound of a man's words comes unto the Lord, for the ear of jealousy heareth all things.

“Therefore beware of murmuring, which is unprofitable; and refrain your tongue from backbiting: for there is no word so secret, that shall go for nought: and the mouth that belieth slayeth the soul.” The mouth that belieth, that slanders a brother, a sister, the leadership, or the Lord, slayeth the soul.

Many speak evil against leadership because they do not like when judgment comes out. A problem with the leadership the Most High set up is a problem with the Most High Himself.

precepts.text: Froward means contrary; Saul set his mind on the contrary of what the Most High commanded, and the holy spirit of discipline fled the deceit and would not dwell in a body subject unto sin.
precepts.point: Why did the spirit leave Saul? Wisdom walks with a man by crooked ways at the first and tries him by her laws. Saul was put through a trial, whether he would keep the commandment given through the mouth of the prophet, and he went wrong; so the spirit forsook him and he was given over to his own ruin, that abyss of jealousy, envy, and hatred.

note.label: 1 Samuel 16: The Lord Looketh on the Heart

precepts.why:
“For froward thoughts separate from God: and his power, when it is tried, reproveth the unwise.” Froward means contrary. Saul set his mind on the contrary of what the Most High commanded.

“For into a malicious soul wisdom shall not enter; nor dwell in the body that is subject unto sin. For the holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit, and remove from thoughts that are without understanding, and will not abide when unrighteousness cometh in.” The holy spirit of discipline fled Saul’s deceit and would not dwell in a body subject unto sin, and his servants could see what came in its place: “an evil spirit from God”.

precepts.text: Into a malicious soul wisdom shall not enter; sin comes in and wisdom goes out. Ahab was full of sin, so his wisdom was hindered and he had thoughts without understanding, blaming the righteous man for his own doings.
precepts.point: Elijah commanded that all Israel be gathered to Mount Carmel with the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of the groves that eat at Jezebel's table. Jezebel was the one feeding these eight hundred and fifty false prophets and encouraging them, and Ahab never checked her.

note.label: 1 Kings 18: The Lord, He Is the God

precepts.why:
“For froward thoughts separate from God”. “For into a malicious soul wisdom shall not enter; nor dwell in the body that is subject unto sin.” Sin comes in and wisdom goes out. “For the holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit, and remove from thoughts that are without understanding, and will not abide when unrighteousness cometh in.”

That is Ahab. He was full of sin, so his wisdom was hindered and he had thoughts without understanding. When he saw Elijah he said, “Art thou he that troubleth Israel?” That is the mind of a wicked person: he blamed the ordained prophet of God for the trouble rather than his own wickedness. When the spirit is gone, wisdom cannot enter a malicious soul.

Elijah answered him with the truth: “I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father’s house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the Lord, and thou hast followed Baalim.” It was Ahab following the sin of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, worshipping the golden calves, that brought the trouble.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 11 A Time Of Defamation

precepts.why:
“For froward thoughts separate from God:” You will always see it; even the person that is bugging, in the early phases of bugging, feels it, because they know what they are saying doesn't sound right, but it feels good, and they don't really have a scripture for it. Froward thoughts separate from the Most High. You have to be that brother and sister when you start hearing these things that are separating from the Bible, that are unbiblical, that ain't according to the scripture: stomp it right in its tracks. You have to be that backbone: if I don't say nothing, nobody will. If every person in here had that thought process we would be straight; these doctrines would get crushed. But because folks are like, I'm not really like that, these things happen.

“and his power, when it is tried, reproveth the unwise. For into a malicious soul wisdom shall not enter; nor dwell in the body that is subject unto sin.” You will start to see, because you don't want to check it, the understanding and the spirit leaving that person slowly; next thing you know they are up here talking about we are eating pancakes and bacon and eggs for the Passover. In the world, around Passover it is bake all you can bake, pastries everywhere; you are doing the same thing as the world. If we don't check it, brothers and sisters, it will destroy you. You are watchmen; your job description is in 2 Corinthians 10:5. Cast down any imagination, any nonsense that comes out; throw it to the ground violently, not literally, but don't play with it.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 21 Thy Kingdom Come

precepts.why: Also read by the other speaker. “Seek not death in the error of your life: and pull not upon yourselves destruction with the works of your hands”: you’re getting yourself the death; you’re causing it. “For God made not death”.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 21 Thy Kingdom Come

precepts.why: “But ungodly men with their works and words called it to them”: with their actions and their words, their murmurings, they called death to themselves. “For when they thought to have it their friend”: they thought it was righteousness, even though it was death. “Because they are worthy to take part with it”: worthy of dying, based upon their words and their works. A speaker adds: anyone receiving that should say thank you, this is an opportunity for me to save my life, because you’re warning me of what the Most High said. Instead they say I hate you, so they don’t believe the scriptures and don’t want correction.

moments.label: Character & Integrity: The Hidden Strength Behind Wisdom

points: A froward thought means it is your worldly thought. You want to do what you want to do; you don't want to do what the Lord is telling you to do. You think you know better than the Lord, you think you know better than the men that rule over you. That means your mind ain't on the Lord at all; you're separating yourself by your own thoughts, which means ultimately you lack character, you lack integrity.

note.label: Character & Integrity: The Hidden Strength Behind Wisdom

points: Wisdom cannot enter somebody with a malicious soul: a person that can't be corrected, that don't have good moral character. Some brothers know all the scriptures, but they can't keep rank, they always having issues. You know all these scriptures, why are you not applying them? That is because you have bad judgment, bad moral character.

note.label: Character & Integrity: The Hidden Strength Behind Wisdom

points: When you have discipline, the Holy Spirit of discipline is going to flee deceit, and will not abide when unrighteousness cometh in.

note.label: Character & Integrity: The Hidden Strength Behind Wisdom

points: He that speaketh unrighteous things cannot be hid. When you lack character, when you lack integrity, you do something that you know is wrong, eventually those things are going to come out; there is no getting around it. The Lord will reveal that stuff, and it comes out when it is supposed to come out.

note.label: Character & Integrity: The Hidden Strength Behind Wisdom

points: Seek not death in the error of your life. Some mistakes kill, and eating too much is one of them.
A brother claimed he ate one meal a day, yet he snacked from morning to night. Calling the snacks something other than meals does not change what they do to the body.
The holy spirit of discipline flees deceit and will not abide when unrighteousness comes in.
Stop overeating and snacking, fast more, exercise, and ask the Lord never to remove that spirit of discipline.
